001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.opencsv.CSVReader;
004import com.opencsv.CSVWriter;
005import com.opencsv.exceptions.CsvValidationException;
006import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.path.IColumnSelector;
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.io.InputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStream;
011import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.List;
014
015/**
016 * CSV Filter Command Class
017 *
018 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from CSV using column selectors. Unlike CsvWalker
019 * which applies transformations, CsvFilterCommand only extracts/filters columns based on specified
020 * column names or indices without any modifications.
021 *
022 * <p>Features: - Extract specific columns using column names or indices - Preserve exact data
023 * values from extracted columns - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for multiple
024 * column selection
025 */
026public class CsvFilterCommand implements IStreamCommand {
027
028  private final IColumnSelector combinedSelector;
029  private final boolean hasHeader;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
033   *
034   * @param columnSelector the typed IColumnSelector to extract
035   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
036   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null
037   */
038  private CsvFilterCommand(IColumnSelector columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
039    this.combinedSelector = columnSelector;
040    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector (assumes header exists).
045   *
046   * @param columnSelector the typed IColumnSelector to extract
047   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
048   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null
049   */
050  public static CsvFilterCommand create(IColumnSelector columnSelector) {
051    return create(columnSelector, true);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
056   *
057   * @param columnSelector the typed IColumnSelector to extract
058   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
059   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
060   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null
061   */
062  public static CsvFilterCommand create(IColumnSelector columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
063    if (columnSelector == null) {
064      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
065    }
066    return new CsvFilterCommand(columnSelector, hasHeader);
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
071    // opencsv の readNext() は下位ストリームの IOException を EOF として握りつぶすため、
072    // FaultReportingReader を介して close 時に記録済み障害を必ず再スローする（#784）
073    try (FaultReportingReader reader = FaultReportingReader.forUtf8(inputStream);
074        CSVReader csvReader = new CSVReader(reader);
075        CSVWriter csvWriter =
076            new CSVWriter(
077                new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
078                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_SEPARATOR,
079                CSVWriter.DEFAULT_QUOTE_CHARACTER,
080                // RFC 4180 §5: only doubled-quote escaping, no backslash escape
081                CSVWriter.NO_ESCAPE_CHARACTER,
082                // RFC4180_LINE_END (\r\n) per RFC 4180 §2.
083                CSVWriter.RFC4180_LINE_END)) {
084
085      List<Integer> columnIndices;
086
087      String[] firstRow = csvReader.readNext();
088      if (firstRow == null) {
089        csvWriter.flush();
090        return;
091      }
092
093      if (hasHeader) {
094        columnIndices = mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(combinedSelector, firstRow);
095        // Write filtered header
096        writeFilteredRow(csvWriter, firstRow, columnIndices);
097      } else {
098        // No header — column selectors must be numeric indices
099        columnIndices = parseNumericColumnSelectors(combinedSelector, firstRow.length);
100        // Write filtered first data row
101        writeFilteredRow(csvWriter, firstRow, columnIndices);
102      }
103
104      // Process remaining rows
105      String[] row;
106      // Read and filter each remaining record until the CSV reader reaches EOF.
107      while ((row = csvReader.readNext()) != null) {
108        writeFilteredRow(csvWriter, row, columnIndices);
109      }
110
111      csvWriter.flush();
112    } catch (CsvValidationException e) {
113      throw new IOException("Failed to parse CSV: " + e.getMessage(), e);
114    } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
115      throw new IOException("Invalid column selector: " + e.getMessage(), e);
116    }
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Map column selectors to column indices using Don't Ask Tell pattern
121   *
122   * @param csvPath the CSV path containing multiple selectors
123   * @param headers array of header names
124   * @return list of column indices
125   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no columns found
126   */
127  private List<Integer> mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(IColumnSelector csvPath, String[] headers) {
128    List<Integer> indices = csvPath.resolve(headers);
129    if (indices.isEmpty()) {
130      throw new IllegalArgumentException("No columns found for selector: " + csvPath.toString());
131    }
132    return indices;
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Parse numeric column selectors when no header exists using Don't Ask Tell pattern
137   *
138   * @param csvPath the CSV path containing column selectors
139   * @param totalColumns total number of columns available
140   * @return list of column indices
141   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no valid indices found
142   */
143  private List<Integer> parseNumericColumnSelectors(IColumnSelector csvPath, int totalColumns) {
144    List<Integer> indices = csvPath.resolve(totalColumns);
145    if (indices.isEmpty()) {
146      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
147          "Column selector must be numeric when no header: " + csvPath.toString());
148    }
149    return indices;
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Write filtered row with only selected columns. Quotes are applied only when required by RFC
154   * 4180 (fields containing commas, quotes, or newlines).
155   *
156   * @param csvWriter output writer
157   * @param fields all field values
158   * @param columnIndices indices of columns to include
159   */
160  private void writeFilteredRow(CSVWriter csvWriter, String[] fields, List<Integer> columnIndices) {
161    String[] filteredRow = new String[columnIndices.size()];
162    for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.size(); i++) {
163      int columnIndex = columnIndices.get(i);
164      filteredRow[i] = columnIndex < fields.length ? fields[columnIndex] : "";
165    }
166    // applyQuotesToAll=false: only quote fields that contain delimiters or quotes
167    csvWriter.writeNext(filteredRow, false);
168  }
169}
